head: rong
rule: All seven file under sense 1, the roofed building, and the reason is worth stating: senses 1 and 2 are not distinguishable from their glosses. Sense 1 is สิ่งปลูกสร้างที่มีหลังคาคลุม and sense 2 is เรียกสิ่งปลูกสร้างเช่นนั้น — 'calling such a structure that' — which names a way of referring rather than a different meaning. Nothing in a compound's gloss can tell the two apart, so I put the buildings in sense 1, where โรงพิมพ์ already sits, rather than split them on a distinction I cannot state. โรงบาล goes with โรงพยาบาล, being its clipped form, and นายโรง files here too — the โรง is the likay house he owns or leads.
